title: Dingy Cellar

wall.description: Old ochre-coated stone/brick masonry with chipped plaster residue in regular courses

ground.description: weathered dark sandstone rectangular paving, muted umber and gray, orthogonal grid with irregular joints

structure.description: aged dark brown oak boards, straight grain and small nail marks, full square wooden surface

detail.description: square patch of old woven burlap sackcloth with a subtle stitched central grain-sheaf motif, nonrepeating flat textile

asset_recipe.notes: Cracked 2×2 m floor tile with top at local Y=0.
Staggered ashlar courses with actual relief and mortar gaps.
Round arch through-wall, 1.4 m wide / 2.4 m clear rectangular passage.
Faceted barrel with two raised metal hoops.
Braced wooden crate with diagonal front reinforcement.
Solid-backed three-shelf cabinet; fill with separately instanced props.
Potion bottle geometry with shoulder and long neck, opaque preview material.
Box lantern with capped roof and hanging spindle; use separate emissive adapter.
Rectangular inn table with four legs.
Faceted urn / potion container with broad body and narrow neck.
Square timber upright with foot shoe.

assembly.notes: GLB is texture-bound cutaway showcase. All instance transforms baked into vertices. Import GLB OR layout, not both.

originality_notes: Original generated surface art and original parametric geometry; generic public names, no source-world logos, characters or copied layouts.

qa.preview_status: actual GLB rendered by Blender Cycles CPU; visual inspection recorded separately
qa.texture_status: diffuse candidates; no PBR data maps or seamless certification
qa.duplicate_scene_routes: do not import both assembly GLB and layout instances

native_preview_camera.note: diagnostic fixed camera; runtime controller/back-offset untested

visual_review.scope: Actual GLB overview and native320x240 contact-cell inspection, plus full-size pilot and onebit views. Independent second-agent review corroborated all themed views.
known_limits: Diagnostic cutaway galleries reuse a common test layout and do not reproduce full concept worlds.
Bright pale/crystal surfaces may lose fine detail in this studio lighting.
Dense diffuse/engraved textures can shimmer; motion and target performance not tested.
Texture repeat candidates are not mathematically seamless-certified.
Onebit contour/Bayer display is a separate render-pipeline proposal, not baked game behavior.

qa.derived_overview_delivery: Not bundled; reviewed in authoring, regenerate with render_themes.py.
